name: Laplace
plain: Places log sigma on a Laplace-shaped curve so steps cluster around exp(μ), a mid-range noise level, and clamps the result to the given range. Node only.
math:
x_i = linspace(0,1,n), ε=1e-5.
λ_i = μ − β·sign(0.5−x_i)·ln(1 − 2|0.5−x_i| + ε).
σ_i = clamp(exp(λ_i), σmin, σmax). No trailing zero is appended.

props.shape: Laplace quantile in ln σ, clamped

label: from code
surprise: Unlike every other core get_sigmas_*, Laplace appends no zero: it returns n values, so n−1 steps, ending at sigma_min with residual noise (sampling.py:58-59).
